verdict.rationale: Evidence documents recording/transcription (desktop app, live transcription with speaker recognition) and a shared searchable workspace organized by team/project/topic with full-text search across meetings, but the pack never explicitly mentions a mobile app for in-person conversation capture — only desktop recording and bot-based online meeting capture are cited. Missing for 10: explicit mobile-app in-person recording documentation, confirmation that mobile-captured notes sync into the same workspace/search index as other meetings.
